record.content: The official camping page identifies Eagles View as a primitive group campsite for 17 to 50 people with a lake view, picnic tables, BBQs, a fire ring, and a drinking fountain. Flush toilets are uphill, showers are unavailable, beer and wine require an additional $25 permit, ten parking passes are issued, and buses, RVs, trailers, food trucks, and caterers are prohibited.
